name: Candle
description: A small wax candle that provides a modest amount of light when lit.
notes: Light it with a tinderbox: it goes into your off hand and burns for 1 hour.
A small light, enough to fight by at night (no need with darkvision).
At night in the wild a lit light gives you away: whatever might ambush you sees you coming (−5 Stealth).
Once it goes out, it's spent.
Millhaven's keywarden wants two to fit a vault lock.
